title: Tutorial DNase I hypersensitivity and genomic annotation files
study_ids: Maurano et al. 2012 DNase I hypersensitivity/regulatory DNA study (as cited in tutorial)

provenance.status: observed data described by tutorial; adaptation/source history partially documented
provenance.description: Tutorial says 20 BED files represent DNase I hypersensitivity sites measured in fetal tissue samples across brain, heart, intestine, kidney, lung, muscle, skin and stomach. It separately describes CpG islands, human RefSeq exons, GWAS-associated SNPs, and hESC ChromHMM predictions; those four are said to come from UCSC Genome Browser Table Browser. Shared tutorial packaging does not establish shared observations.
